KidMode.dc.html.title: Option D — Kid Mode (layer on B)

t1.text: Midterm Tracker — three layout options for the National view

t2.text: Option D — Kid Mode: same data, a friendlier layer (ages 4 and 8)

n1.text: All numbers on these boards are SAMPLE DATA for layout only — not results. Party colors: D blue #3A6FB7 / R red #C0463F / called = solid, leading = hatched + translucent.

n2.text: Option B trades density for readability: one chamber per screen-height, suited to reading on a phone while the TV is on.

n3.text: Option C keeps map and table in view together; table filters drive the map. Best for watching a shortlist of races.

n4.text: Kid Mode ideas not on standard news sites: racetrack to 51/218, 100 chairs, counting jars (instead of % reporting), plain-language ballot questions, Family Picks game, Words to know, 60-second replay for the morning after.

n5.text: Kid Mode is a toggle on the same app, not a separate build: it reads the same normalized races/snapshots. 'Grown-up mode' = Option B or C.
